tasks.description: Enforce rate limits using a token-bucket algorithm scoped to each API key. This will ensure each key gets an independent allowance. The algorithm should be designed to handle a high volume of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid API key, when the token bucket is full, then the request is allowed
Given a valid API key, when the token bucket is empty, then the request is rejected with a 429 status

tasks.description: Make the bucket capacity and refill rate configurable via application configuration. This should not require code changes to adjust them. The configuration should be stored in a central location.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configuration file, when the bucket capacity is updated, then the new capacity is applied
Given a configuration file, when the refill rate is updated, then the new refill rate is applied

tasks.description: Store rate-limit counters/state in Redis so limits are enforced consistently across all server instances. This will ensure that the counters are shared across all instances.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Redis connection, when a counter is updated, then the update is persisted to Redis
Given a Redis connection, when a counter is retrieved, then the correct value is returned

tasks.description: When a key exceeds its limit, reject the request with an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) status. This should include a Retry-After header indicating how long the client should wait before retrying.
acceptance_criteria: Given an exceeded limit, when a request is made, then a 429 status is returned
Given an exceeded limit, when a request is made, then a Retry-After header is included in the response

tasks.summary: Write unit tests for rate limiting
tasks.description: Write unit tests to ensure the rate limiting functionality is working as expected. This should include tests for the token-bucket algorithm, configurable limits, and Redis-backed counters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when the tests are run, then all tests pass
Given a test suite, when a test is added, then the test is included in the suite

tasks.summary: Integrate rate limiting with API routes
tasks.description: Integrate the rate limiting middleware with the API routes. This should ensure that the rate limiting is applied uniformly to all authenticated API traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API route, when a request is made, then the rate limiting is applied
Given an API route, when a request is made, then the correct response is returned

tasks.description: Include a Retry-After header on 429 responses indicating how long the client should wait before retrying. This should be calculated based on the refill rate and the number of tokens remaining in the bucket.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 429 response, when the Retry-After header is included, then the correct value is returned
Given a 429 response, when the Retry-After header is included, then the client waits the correct amount of time before retrying
